cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import harness; harness.setup_env()
import reference, formats, pipeline
norm = lambda o: json.dumps(o, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
def drow(seq):
    values = [1100,1200,1300] + list(seq) + [1400,1420,1450,1480]
    acts = [0,0,0] + [1000]*len(seq) + [0,0,0,0]
    return {'class': 0, 'values': values, 'activation': acts}
A = [(v,)*4 for v in (1600,1560,1570,1580)]
B = [(v,)*4 for v in (1700,1740,1730,1720)]
X = [(1650,)*4]
val = [{'class':0,'values':[1600,1600,1600,1600]},{'class':0,'values':[1700,1700,1700,1700]},
       {'class':0,'values':[1650,1650,1650,1650]}]
train=[{'class':0,'values':[1600,1600,1600,1600]}]
for label, order in (('A first', A+B+X), ('B first', B+A+X), ('X first', X+A+B)):
    rows=[drow(s) for s in order]
    spec={'id':'m','classes':1,'width':4,'eps':[60,1],'ratio':[3,8],'threshold':[0,1],
          'mode':'range','packet_limit':4,'idle_us':0,'discovery':rows,'train':train,'validation':val}
    req={'capacity':{'range':9,'exact':9},'releases':[spec],'blocks':[]}
    mine = pipeline.execute(formats.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req))))
    theirs = reference.execute(req)
    cat=mine['catalog'][0]
    print(label, 'agree', norm(mine)==norm(theirs), [(c['id'],c['members'],c['core']) for c in cat['clusters']], 'noise', cat['noise'], 'kept', cat['priority'])
PYEOF
